mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.token, q.title, q.content, q.is_active AS isActive, q.created_by AS createdBy, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.expires_at AS expiresAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record r WHERE r.qr_id = q.id) AS recordCount FROM tb_safety_qr q ORDER BY q.created_at DESC

SELECT q.id, q.token, q.title, q.content, q.is_active AS isActive, q.created_by AS createdBy, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.expires_at AS expiresAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record r WHERE r.qr_id = q.id) AS recordCount FROM tb_safety_qr q WHERE q.id = #{id}

SELECT TOP 1 q.id, q.token, q.title, q.content, q.is_active AS isActive, q.created_by AS createdBy, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.expires_at AS expiresAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record r WHERE r.qr_id = q.id) AS recordCount FROM tb_safety_qr q WHERE q.is_active = 1 ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
SELECT id, token, title, content, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM tb_safety_qr WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_qr (token, title, content, is_active, created_by, expires_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{title}, #{content}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_safety_qr SET is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_safety_qr SET is_active = 0 WHERE is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_qr_record (qr_id, worker_id, worker_name, vessel_name, work_date, phone) VALUES (#{qrId}, #{workerId}, #{workerName}, #{vesselName}, #{workDate}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.qr_id AS qrId, q.title AS qrTitle, r.worker_name AS workerName, r.vessel_name AS vesselName, r.work_date AS workDate, r.phone, r.completed_at AS completedAt FROM tb_safety_qr_record r JOIN tb_safety_qr q ON q.id = r.qr_id WHERE r.qr_id = #{qrId} ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record WHERE qr_id = #{qrId}

SELECT DISTINCT ar.vessel_id AS vesselId, v.name AS vesselName FROM tb_access_request ar JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = ar.vessel_id WHERE ar.deleted = 0 AND ar.planned_end_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ORDER BY v.name

SELECT DISTINCT ar.company_id AS companyId, c.name AS companyName FROM tb_access_request ar JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ar.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE ar.deleted = 0 AND ar.vessel_id = #{vesselId} AND ar.planned_end_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ORDER BY c.name

SELECT DISTINCT w.id AS workerId, w.worker_name AS workerName, w.worker_phone AS workerPhone FROM tb_access_worker w JOIN tb_access_request ar ON ar.id = w.access_request_id WHERE ar.deleted = 0 AND w.deleted = 0 AND ar.vessel_id = #{vesselId} AND ar.company_id = #{companyId} AND ar.planned_end_date >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ORDER BY w.worker_name
